sentence: This project builds a brain simulation platform that models brain circuits to predict treatment response in psychiatric and neurological disorders.
This project builds a theoretical foundation for cryptography that stays secure against quantum computing.
This project works on quantum computing, including techniques for error detection and ways to evaluate quantum entanglement.
This project studies cybersecurity problems by combining computer science with the social sciences.
This project tests a system built for artificial intelligence research by evaluating its deep learning hardware and software.
This project builds computational methods that find structural variations in genomes from sequencing data.
This project builds data-driven methods to control microgrids and to detect faults and cyber-attacks in them.
This project develops reinforcement learning methods for sequential decision-making problems in healthcare and business.
This project studies non-convex machine learning problems in high-dimensions using mathematical analysis.
This project studies how to design architectures that interact with biological systems and bring about a desired response.
This project studies how human-mediated selection changed flower traits and pollinator foraging preferences in domesticated plants.
This project connects many quantum processing units to form a virtual quantum machine with far more qubits than a single unit.
This project builds techniques that make graph representation learning more efficient on large graph data stored in modern data lakes.
This project sets up a graphics processing unit cluster for running artificial intelligence models on sensitive healthcare data.
This project builds a sensing system on drones that uses a deep neural network to measure 3D crop structure.
This project develops tools that monitor coastal zones with remote sensing and artificial intelligence to help communities handle hurricanes and sea-level rise.
